original_test_intent: Measure maximum host-to-GPU and GPU-to-host PCIe DMA bandwidth on every GPU path under symmetric system-memory placement, while proving transferred data integrity and absence of link errors.
original_method: Pin vendor bandwidth module/config; verify DIMM symmetry/NUMA and GPU UUID/BDF/root-port map; allocate isolated test buffers; approve direction, size, iterations, concurrency and throughput oracle; drain workloads; preserve logs; run bounded DMA with pattern verification, link/AER/thermal telemetry; free buffers and confirm health.
manual_activity: Memory/PCIe owner confirms DIMM topology, safe buffers and performance oracle; operator approves saturation window and recovery.
required_inputs: GPU path plus NUMA/DIMM-channel placement map
Safe allocated host/GPU buffers and integrity pattern
safety_requirements: Hard-block unproven DMA targets or buffers
Never use production data/storage as DMA backing
Abort on corruption, AER, XID, thermal, IOMMU or management anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Free buffers and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic vendor execution omits DMA buffer ownership, directions and bandwidth/integrity acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use pinned vendor module with dedicated buffers and explicit per-path bidirectional parameters after DDR symmetry verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PCIe saturation, system/GPU-memory DMA and DDR symmetry prerequisite are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a per-GPU/direction/size throughput and integrity table tied to NUMA placement and negotiated link state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe memory ownership, data integrity and numeric oracle.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable bandwidth number or firmware string alone cannot prove correct DMA or expected performance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: System-memory bandwidth/NUMA placement may bottleneck PCIe; saturation can disturb live workloads.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner defines whether the oracle is theoretical link efficiency, golden-system baseline or product floor for each topology.
expected_evidence: Artifact/config, GPU/NUMA/DIMM topology and link baseline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires high-load DMA bandwidth and symmetric-memory validation, while Criteria only check readable text and firmware; log clearing would erase diagnostics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Dedicated safe buffers and project inputs can make execution possible; ambiguous targets hard-block only the run.

review_improvement: Adds safe DMA ownership and data-integrity evidence while retaining the system-memory topology prerequisite.
independent_technical_reasoning: A low result can originate in DDR channel imbalance or NUMA placement rather than the PCIe link, while a high throughput result can still conceal data corruption. The test therefore needs both topology-controlled bandwidth and end-to-end pattern verification.
